mapper.insert: insert into book(name, author, publisher, stock, category) values(#{name}, #{author}, #{publisher}, #{stock}, #{category})
mapper.update: update book set name=#{name}, author=#{author}, publisher=#{publisher}, stock=#{stock}, category=#{category} where id=#{id}
update book set stock = stock - 1 where id=#{id} and stock > 0
update book set stock = stock + 1 where id=#{id}
